caption: The drawing depicts a metallic andiron, predominantly colored in shades of gold and brass with subtle highlights for a metallic sheen. The object has a decorative, ornate vertical post featuring two bulbous, vertically ribbed sections stacked atop each other, tapering at the ends and separated by a thinner cylindrical section. The post is supported by a square base with three curved legs ending in clawed feet. A horizontal bar is attached to the back, extending away from the viewer and shaded in darker tones. In the upper left corner, there is a detailed technical elevation and plan view of the same andiron, outlined in black ink with dimensions marked, showing measurements in inches on a grid. The drawing is encased within a thin, rectangular border, and the artist's signature and date, "Hans Korsch 1936," are located in the lower right corner. The background is a light, off-white color with slight tonal shading beneath the object to indicate the shadow.
title: Andiron
